abstract_sentences.text: Recent research has established that the impact of context in a vanilla transformer can be represented implicitly by forming a token-dependent, rank-1 patch to its MLP weights.
This work extends that foundational theory to the diverse architectures of modern Large Language Models.

We first demonstrate a precise, analytical solution for a Gemma-style transformer block, proving that the entire effect of a context can be perfectly mapped to rank-1 patches on its MLP weight matrices and a patch to the RMSNorm scale.

evidence.anchor: analytical solution for a Gemma-style transformer block

abstract_sentences.text: We then generalize this result, providing a constructive proof and algorithm for multi-layer models.

evidence.anchor: constructive proof and algorithm for multi-layer models

abstract_sentences.text: To unify these findings, we introduce a general framework centered on two core properties: input controllability and output controllability.
We prove that a perfect implicit weight patch is possible for any MLP block where the inner function is input-controllable and the outer function is output-controllable.

evidence.anchor: perfect implicit weight patch is possible

abstract_sentences.text: This provides a simpler and more powerful lens for understanding how transformer models transmute prompts into effective weights.
This setup generalizes to a wide range of modern LLM architectures including gating, pre-/post-norm, mixture of experts and sequential/parallel transformer blocks.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 将 context 造成的 attention/residual 差分分成内部输入校正和外部输出补偿；只要 inner/outer controllability 与非零条件成立，token-dependent parameter patches 就能复现 full-context 当前 token 输出。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: Theorem 1–3、核心 Eq. 1–4、Algorithm 1、Table 1、Gemma 配对生成、精度失败及显式 limitations 保留在主文，足以读出因果链。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Lemma 1–7、RMSNorm inversion、额外 prompt/Falcon、layer/scaling ablation、Theorem 4 和 gradient-step derivation 移入 appendix；p. 23–25 的浮动图也属于 C 的证据。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 从可检验等式和条件出发，给 constructive patch，再用层间归纳、伪代码和相同-history 的逐 token 图把数学对象与观测对象对齐。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 经验结果没有 token 分母、seed、硬件、运行成本、图像来源或代码；强制 shared history 与逐 token 重算也使自由 rollout 和一次性可复用 patch 仍未闭合。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 对每个跨架构主张，先把组件级假设写成定义/表格，再将 theorem、算法和对应的配对测量放在同一闭环内。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 只有当运算图、可训练自由度、非零/可控性条件与评价历史都明确时，这条规则才可外推；它不支持把 per-token reparameterization 写成持久训练或任意 free generation。
